reviews.author: Tanya Boudreaux
reviews.text: My car looks amazing, ceramic coating and PPF , Skyline Customs did an amazing job! I  would recommend them to anyone looking for a professional and reliable paint protection of your vehicle!

reviews.author: Randi Richardson
reviews.text: These guys are so professional and performed a quality job on the coat. I highly recommend. 10/10!!!

reviews.author: Greg Drew
reviews.text: PPF and ceramic coat came out looking great!

reviews.author: Sahil Desai
reviews.text: Great experience awesome job with my telluride

reviews.author: Miguel Ramos
reviews.text: Knowledge and kind people work here. I'm very happy with how my ppf turned out.

reviews.author: Steven Kim
reviews.text: Skyline custom did an amazing job with full front PPF and ceramic coating. Great communication throughout the whole process. Cant get over how glossy the whole car looks.

reviews.author: James Larosa
reviews.text: These guys are amazing! Great to work with and they have a talented and friendly staff. I entrusted them with my baby and I was not disappointed!!  They installed PPF on the front 1/2 of my car and ceramic coating on the whole car and the results were amazing. The best part is now I can drive my car and not stress about stone chips! I highly recommend Skyline Customs!!

reviews.author: Zharie Grae Aguirre
reviews.text:
got the Tesla Model Y Full Front PPE with whole ceramic coating and Front Window Tint with Skyline Customs! ✨

I have inquired other places but this place got my heart as the Team were easy to talk to, meticulous, explain the process, no intimidation and very professional. i want them to do the work with my car. i feel the heart and dedication they have for the business!

I do Highly recommend this place for PPE, Ceramic and Tint needs!

reviews.author: Nasib Hafeez
reviews.text: Very patient. Worked with me and my situation. Explained everything to me and made sure I was taken care of and left satisfied. Would recommend anyone to get their car taken care of by them. Truly kind and caring people that take pride in their reputation and work

reviews.author: Henry Gates
reviews.text: The guys done a outstanding job they were very professional and didn’t hesitated to help and making the customer happy job well done

reviews.author: Pedro Rivera
reviews.text: I have a 2025 Nissan Pathfinder. I had the ceramic wax (the entire car), front end PPF installed and the two front door windows tinted (see the attached photographs). The workmanship on the vehicle and the customer service was excellent. Skyline Customs did a fantastic job and I greatly appreciate it.  They definitely took care of every detail and were very attentive. I'm looking forward to doing business with them in the future and send any referrals to them. If you're looking for professional work and great customer service at a great price, I highly recommend Skyline Customs!!

reviews.author: Paolo Miclat
reviews.text: Great people to deal with. Owner was very transparent with all their services and they offer payment plans. I got the front half of my car PPF'd and back half ceramic coated (one of the packages they offered) and has been raining for a few days on an off. You cant even tell it rained. The PPF and ceramic coat works as intended.

reviews.author: Youngsu Kim
reviews.text:
​I highly recommend these guys! They did an excellent job on both the front end PPF installation and the two front window tints. The attention to detail they put into their work is awesome, and everything looks flawless.
​On top of the great quality, the staff is incredibly friendly and very flexible with scheduling. If you're looking for professional work and great customer service, this is the place to go. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Clara Kim
reviews.text: Good friend of mine recommended me to get the tints done from skyline and i can confidently say that my car looks awesome. I work from 8:30-6 so they were super flexible with my schedule, letting me drop my car off in the morning and pick it up later. I appreciate the work and happy with it!!

reviews.author: Jonathan Cao
reviews.text: Got my new to me car tinted by Skyline Customs. Everyone was super friendly and extremely patient, I had to reschedule multiple times and they were very accommodating. Professional quality work done at a great price,  I highly recommend their services and will be returning for future work!

reviews.author: Moeez Omer
reviews.text: An Excellent and professional team. I got my rear and side windows tinted and the process was exceptional from the jump. The gave me a step by step process which gave me full confidence with my purchase. Will definitely come back for my mother’s car!
